BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2690.name: Agumon -Bond of Courage-
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2690.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red/Purple & Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

When your Life is at three or less, you can [Advent] this card from the Hand onto your "Agumon"-named Spirit, ignoring the condition and treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. If you control any exactly-named "Yagami Taichi", this effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Armor].

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When any opposing Spirit/Ultimate is depleted/destroyed, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4984.name: Ichijouji Ken
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4984.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Green/Blue & Rookie/Champion/Ultimate/Mega)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus' symbol is also treated as Blue.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) By exhausting an opposing Spirit, put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control/your Reserve.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your Green "Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirits are attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.

[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus' symbol is also treated as Green.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Turn)
Your Blue "Ultimate"/"Mega" family Spirits are unaffected by opposing Nexus/Magic effects.
